messages:
cassie-docs: Quick PSA: our README quickstart has a couple of copy/paste drifts that keep tripping up new signups. Saw three issues in the onboarding session: env var mismatch, incorrect field name in response, and a sync/async mismatch in the JS snippet.

cassie-docs: Current bad JS snippet in docs:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY)
const result = client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi' })
console.log(result.text)
```

ron-support: ugh. customers paste that into their app and get a Promise object or undefined. Also REDWOOD_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY keeps showing up in support tickets.

ida-sdk: Proposed minimal fix: use object-style constructor, await the call, and use the canonical response field `output`. Also add a tiny note about Node versions for top-level await.

ida-sdk: Fixed snippet suggestion:
```js
// Node >=16.8 (top-level await)
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi' })
console.log(res.output)
```

anya-devex: please also add a short Python example and a one-line security reminder: "Do not paste API keys in public repos/gists." I'll open a tiny PR and add a docs CI smoke test to execute the snippets against a mock server so future drift is caught.

ci-bot: created job examples/snippet-smoke-tests and queued a run that starts a mock server and executes JS/Python snippet runners.

cassie-docs: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1204 1 updates README quickstart (env var, await, response field), adds Python example, and wires up smoke test. Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/quickstart/1204

ron-support: verified preview and added a support KB note about env var naming. Thanks for the quick turn.

anya-devex: merging once CI green. Follow-up: schedule monthly snippet smoke runs to proactively detect regressions. Closing thread after merge. :white_check_mark:
